name: VANZO
recent: VANZO 近期没有业务或合约公告，主要是董事与大股东在闭门期内的股权交易申报。董事 Wong Liang Tzer 多次以间接方式增持，董事 Choe Sook Ling 则有一笔 500 万股间接减持。公司也发布了股息除权的 Book Closure 通知。
notable: 董事 Wong Liang Tzer 于 2026 年 11 月多次以间接方式增持公司股份。
董事 Choe Sook Ling 于 2026 年 11 月 3 日间接减持 500 万股。
公司发布 Book Closure 通知，涉及股息除权与登记日期。
risks: 董事 Choe Sook Ling 在闭门期内间接减持 500 万股，占 1.071%。
多名董事与大股东在闭门期内持续申报股权变动。

VANZO - Notice of Book Closure

recent_en: VANZO has had no business or contract announcements recently; the filings are mainly director and substantial shareholder dealings during the closed period. Director Wong Liang Tzer acquired shares indirectly several times, while director Choe Sook Ling made a 5 million share indirect disposal. The company also issued a book closure notice for dividend entitlement.
notable_en: Director Wong Liang Tzer acquired shares indirectly several times in November 2026.
Director Choe Sook Ling indirectly disposed of 5 million shares on 3 November 2026.
The company issued a book closure notice covering dividend ex-date and entitlement date.
risks_en: Director Choe Sook Ling indirectly disposed of 5 million shares, or 1.071%, during the closed period.
Several directors and substantial shareholders continued to report changes in shareholdings during the closed period.
